mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by > 1pp y-o-y and the unemployment rate is rising, it signals a supply-driven economic slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO y-o-y growth < -1pp and UNRATE rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5% and the CPI inflation rate is above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, defined as a 2% m-o-m decline, signals a sudden weakening in consumer demand that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines > 2% m-o-m but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Steadily falling unemployment, defined as a 0.5pp decline over 6 months, signals an improving labor market and strengthening consumer spending that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls by > 0.5pp over 6 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth slows by > 5pp y-o-y and industrial production growth is also negative y-o-y, it signals a broad supply-side slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST y-o-y growth < -5pp and INDPRO y-o-y growth < 0, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid 1pp increase in the federal funds rate over 3 months, when the rate is already above 3%, signals an aggressive monetary tightening that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 1pp in 3 months when FEDFUNDS > 3%
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises > 1pp in 3 months when FEDFUNDS > 3%, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
